targets.outcome_quote:
In this
paper, we explicitly set out to conduct a replication, and
our findings are opposite to those in the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that the replication findings are opposite to the original. Recreating negative estimates in rare simulated samples explains the original sample; it is not their overall replication verdict. Unchanged null or positive ancillary comparisons do not outweigh the overall verdict.

reasoning: Full paper title, DOI and three authors match. Uses a much larger sample from the original population, explicitly described as new data, to re-test two published findings from one original paper. Therefore replication rather than reanalysis of the original own sample. References to learning studies and methodological works are background only.
